notes: HPI is the Philadelphia, PA metropolitan division (MSAD 37964), not the full Philadelphia-Camden-Wilmington MSA (the MSA-level URL ATNHPIUS37980Q failed to fetch). FHFA all-transactions, Q4 basis, continuous 1976-2025. Property tax: SmartAsset (no year) Philadelphia County 0.83%, PA state 1.16%; ATTOM 2025 annual tax report gives Philadelphia metro 1.41% and PA 1.24% for 2025 (https://www.attomdata.com/news/market-trends/home-sales-prices/2025-annual-tax-report). Use 1.41% if modeling suburbs. Alternative insurance: NerdWallet (May 6, 2026) PA $1,720/yr at $400,000 dwelling.
